caption: The drawing depicts a large ornate pitcher, rendered with colors including gold, white, blue, brown, green, and red. The pitcher features a wide, curving spout and a handle adorned with small gold oval patterns and a vertical floral motif in gold and brown. At the top center of the pitcher, just below the rim and spout, is an illustration of a bald eagle with outstretched wings, a shield of red, white, and blue on its chest, and arrows and olive branches in its talons, all positioned above green foliage. The main body of the pitcher displays a detailed waterfront scene with a pier, several buildings, boats on blue water, greenery along the shore, and distant ships with white sails against a cloudy sky. In the upper left section of the drawing, there is a small illustration of two crossed American flags surrounded by green branches, labeled as the decoration for "under spout on front," and to the right, a vertical gold floral design labeled "back of handle." The edges and contours of the pitcher are highlighted with gold accents, and the base has a gold band. The overall composition is drawn on a beige background, and the artist’s signature, "chas Ossola," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
